lines.en: The worst that could happen is that she turns into an unrecognizable Lovecraftian horror who tears my limbs from my body and uses secretions from her tongue to dissolve my torso and pelvic area.
lines.zh: 最坏的情况,是她变成一个面目全非的克苏鲁式恐怖,把我的四肢从身体上撕下,再用她舌头的分泌物溶解我的躯干和骨盆区域。

lines.en: But I’m sure nothing like that will happen because this isn’t that type of story.
lines.zh: 但我确信那种事不会发生,因为这不是那种故事。

lines.en: This is a redemption tale of Kumon-mi’s most hideous individual — a man who goes from predator to parent. And I’m glad that I have someone like you to tag along for the ride with me.
lines.zh: 这是 Kumon-mi 最可憎之人的救赎故事——一个从捕食者变成家长的男人。而我很高兴,有你这样的人陪我踏上这段旅程。

lines.en: Because as I stare past this potential demon and in through the windows of suburban homes as they zoom past us, I realize it’s going to be a long one.
lines.zh: 因为,把视线从这尊潜在恶魔身上挪开、望向随巴士疾驰而过的郊区住宅的窗户时,我意识到,这将是一段漫长的旅程。

lines.en: I also realize that I must have left the better me at the bus stop as I can, once again, not help but be swallowed by the metaphorical quicksand that is my permanently indeterminate mental state.
lines.zh: 我也意识到,更好的那个我一定是被落在了巴士站——因为我又一次无法自拔,被那片名为「永久悬置精神状态」的隐喻流沙吞没。

lines.en: The difference this time is that no one is in danger but me.
lines.zh: 这次的不同在于,身处险境的只有我。

lines.en: It’s because I feel like there is something else on the bus.
lines.zh: 因为我感觉,巴士上还有别的东西。

lines.en: It’s because I feel like we’re being followed.
lines.zh: 因为我感觉,我们正被跟踪。

lines.en: And I can not figure out whether I want to shield this tiny creature with my own body or lift her up and offer her as a sacrifice to whatever unknown entity wants to crawl inside of me.
lines.zh: 而我无法分清,我究竟想用自己的身体护住这个小生物,还是把她举起来,献祭给任何想爬进我体内的未知存在。

lines.en: Please find peace in her instead — as she is far more pure than I will ever be.
lines.zh: 请改为在她身上寻得安宁——因为她远比将来的我纯洁。

lines.en: Just kidding.
lines.zh: 开玩笑的。

lines.en: Nao is my responsibility until the end of the day.
lines.zh: 今天之内,Nao 都是我的责任。

lines.en: And I will never let anything bad happen to her.
lines.zh: 而我绝不允许任何坏事发生在她身上。

lines.en: For if I did, I’d never stop regretting it.
lines.zh: 因为若发生了,我将悔恨至死方休。

lines.en: I don’t know why I feel this way.
lines.zh: 我不知道自己为何有这种感觉。

lines.en: I just know that I do.
lines.zh: 我只知道,我有。

lines.en: : Are you hungry?
lines.zh: : 你饿了吗?

lines.en: : I’m going to take that as a yes.
lines.zh: : 我就当这是「饿了」了。

lines.en: : In hindsight, I probably should have thought a little harder about dragging you around all day without feeding you since I’m pretty sure that’s supposed to be my responsibility as well.
lines.zh: : 事后想想,拖着你逛了一整天却不喂饭,我大概本该多想一层——因为我相当确定,那也算我的责任。

lines.en: : To be fair though, some of it falls on you for not reminding me or asking for food at any point.
lines.zh: : 不过说句公道话,也有一部分怪你——你全程都没提醒我,也没开口要吃的。

lines.en: : Yes, I know you’re incapable of speaking. But you could have pointed at one of the hundred food stalls or cafes we passed in the mall.
lines.zh: : 是,我知道你说不了话。但商场上百家小吃摊和咖啡店,你随便指一家也行啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...now you know for next time.
lines.zh: : 是啊,这个嘛……下次你就知道了。

lines.en: : Just out of curiosity, what happens if you try to speak?
lines.zh: : 纯粹好奇,你试着说话的话,会发生什么?

lines.en: : Like...what happens if you open your mouth and try to...make noise come out of it? Have you attempted that at all?
lines.zh: : 就是……你张开嘴,试着……让声音出来,会发生什么?你试过吗?

lines.en: : I know Kaori’s trying to teach you how to read at the moment, but developing some way to communicate vocally would probably be a little more useful than that, don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我知道 Kaori 现在正在教你认字,但开发一种用声音交流的方式,大概比那更有用一点,你不觉得吗?

lines.en: : At the very least, it’d be polite to try. Not being able to talk isn’t just an inconvenience to you, but everyone else as well. There are only so many signs you can hold up to convey how you’re feeling.
lines.zh: : 至少,试一试也算礼貌。不能说话不只给你自己带来不便,也给其他人带来不便。你能举的牌子,也就那么多块。

lines.en: : Yes, I know. You regret leaving your notebook behind.
lines.zh: : 是,我知道。你后悔把笔记本落下了。

lines.en: : What? Why are you pointing at me?
lines.zh: : 什么?你指我干什么?

lines.en: : Is it because I was able to understand you without any signs at all? And how me doing that is somehow a testimony to how little you actually need real speech in order to get by?
lines.zh: : 是因为我连牌子都不用就能懂你?还是因为,我做到了这一点,恰好证明你其实几乎不需要真正的言语也能过下去?

lines.en: : You know, maybe this isn’t so difficult after all? The more time I spend with you, the easier it becomes to just sort of understand what you want.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,也许这根本没那么难?和你相处的时间越多,我就越容易大概理解你想要什么。

lines.en: : It would still be cool if you tried, though.
lines.zh: : 不过,你若肯试,还是很酷的。

lines.en: : Do you...not want to speak?
lines.zh: : 你是……不想说话吗?

lines.en: : Mouth?
: Ahh...so you can’t make any noise even if you want to, huh?
lines.zh: : 啊……所以就算你想,也发不出任何声音,是吧?

lines.en: : I guess it can’t be helped then. Maybe your...vocal cords just need to grow in or something first? I have no idea how your mysterious Lovecraftian body works.
lines.zh: : 那大概也没办法了。也许你的……声带得先长出来什么的?你那神秘的克苏鲁身体如何运作,我一无所知。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Instead, why not just try signing out what type of food you want to eat? I’m not really hungry, so anything you want is probably fine.
lines.zh: : 别纠结这个。不如试着比划一下你想吃什么?我不太饿,所以你想吃什么都行。

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t think this is going to work.
lines.zh: : 再一想,我觉得这招行不通。

lines.en: : Why don’t we just stop for ramen? It’s quick and cheap and I feel suddenly compelled to go there for reasons I am not quite sure of.
lines.zh: : 要不我们干脆停下来吃拉面?又快又便宜,而且我忽然被一股力量驱使着想去那里,理由连我自己都不太确定。

lines.en: : Are you trying to tell me that’s what you were signing?
lines.zh: : 你是想告诉我,你刚才比划的就是这个?

lines.en: : Because...noodles are long? That’s what that hand gesture was?
lines.zh: : 因为……面条很长?你刚才那个手势是这个意思?

lines.en: : Your gesturing could use some work too.
lines.zh: : 你的比划水平也有待提高。

lines.en: Against my better judgement, I escort a child to the second half of town.
lines.zh: 违背着更好的判断,我护送一个孩子前往小镇的后半程。

lines.en: It’s the last place I should be taking her and I am fully aware of that, but I cave into this bizarre craving for the thickest, most pungent air because it is what my lungs need.
lines.zh: 那是我最不该带她去的地方,我也完全清楚。但我向这股奇异的渴望投降了——我渴望最浓烈、最刺鼻的空气,因为那正是我的肺需要的。

lines.en: Exhausted and light-headed due to a day’s worth of untainted inhalation, the dreadmist of the Old District rescues me from feelings I struggle to properly convey to you.
lines.zh: 吸了一整天纯净空气,我又累又晕,旧城区的恐怖迷雾将我从那些情绪中拯救出来——那些我难以向你妥善传达的情绪。

lines.en: But being unable to properly convey feelings is a major theme in this wretched world of ours. And it’s made even more prevalent by a young girl who fully embodies this.
lines.zh: 而「无法妥善传达情感」,正是我们这个悲惨世界的一大主题。一个彻底体现这一点的少女,更让它无处不在。

lines.en: Perhaps that is what she is — the physical manifestation of something I’ve had a half-hearted grip on...sent down or up from heaven or hell to serve as a visual reminder of this concept’s importance.
lines.zh: 也许她就是那个东西——我从未真正抓紧的某物的具象化身……自天堂或地狱被遣下或遣上,作为这一概念重要性的视觉提醒。

lines.en: If no one understands you, no one will ever love you.
lines.zh: 如果没有人理解你,就永远不会有人爱你。

lines.en: And if no one ever loves you, it will be impossible to understand anything.
lines.zh: 而如果永远没有人爱你,你也将无法理解任何事。

lines.en: The escort goes well — and the child arrives at Tojo Ramen with her estimated innocence still intact.
lines.zh: 护送进行得很顺利——孩子抵达 Tojo 拉面时,她估算中的纯真依然完好无损。

lines.en: And I arrive with yet another burden.
lines.zh: 而我抵达时,又多了一副重担。

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please let me know if you have any questions about the menu.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo 拉面。对菜单有任何疑问,请尽管问我。

lines.en: : No questions, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 没有疑问,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : In that case, may I ask one?
lines.zh: : 那样的话,我能问一个吗?

lines.en: : This is Nao. She’s a...friend of a friend.
lines.zh: : 这是 Nao。她是个……朋友的朋友。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : Then...Nao, if you have any questions about the menu or would like a recommendation, please let me know. I am the acting proprietor and resident flavor samurai. Those who doubt my power will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 那么……Nao,你要是对菜单有任何疑问,或想要推荐,请告诉我。我是代理店主兼驻店风味武士。质疑我力量者,格杀勿论。

lines.en: : I am only kidding.
lines.zh: : 我只是开玩笑。

lines.en: : You may take a seat wherever you like, but I recommend the spot in the corner. It’s the closest to the fan and you’ll be able to watch me work from there.
lines.zh: : 你想坐哪儿都行,但我推荐角落那个位子。那里离风扇最近,你还能从那儿看我干活。

lines.en: : Does that sound interesting to you?
lines.zh: : 听起来有意思吗?

lines.en: : Excellent choice. Please take a moment to look over the menu. I will take your order momentarily.
lines.zh: : 绝佳的选择。请先过目菜单,我稍后就来为你点单。

lines.en: : You’re...surprisingly good with kids, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你……意外地会应付小孩啊,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : I simply excel in customer service. It’s no more or less than that.
lines.zh: : 我只是精通待客之道。仅此而已,不多不少。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, could I...maybe get a box for my food? I’m running a little late for...stuff.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo,我能……打包吗?我有事……要迟到了。

lines.en: : Absolutely not. What kind of establishment do you think this is, you ungrateful harlot?
lines.zh: : 绝对不行。你以为这是什么店,你这个忘恩负义的荡妇?

lines.en: : Yeah...should’ve seen that coming.
lines.zh: : 是啊……早该料到的。

lines.en: : Hey, Noriko. Are you just getting out of work?
lines.zh: : 嘿,Noriko。你刚下班?

lines.en: : I’m...off tonight. I just came by to...strategize with Tsuneyo for the...contest thing.
lines.zh: : 我……今晚休假。我只是过来……和 Tsuneyo 商量……比赛那件事。

lines.en: : Do you mind if I sit next to you?
lines.zh: : 你介意我坐你旁边吗?

lines.en: : Uhh...no. No, that’s fine. It’s not like I...own the counter or anything.
lines.zh: : 呃……不。不,没关系。又不是我……拥有这个吧台什么的。

lines.en: Noriko begins to uncomfortably shift around in her seat as I take my place beside her...and I’m not going to pretend I don’t understand why.
lines.zh: 我在她身旁坐下,Noriko 开始在座位上不自在地挪动……而我不打算假装不明白为什么。

lines.en: The two of us have barely even made eye contact since Ami interrupted us in my bedroom.
lines.zh: 自从 Ami 在我卧室打断我们之后,我们俩几乎连眼神交流都没有过。

lines.en: I don’t blame her for that, of course. It was my fault for being unable to push my niece away...and if she needs more time to get back to normal with me, so be it.
lines.zh: 当然,我不怪她。是我自己的错,没法把我的侄女推开……如果她需要更多时间才能和我恢复如常,那就随它去。

lines.en: I’m not about to rush her when I told her to her face that I need her to suffer in order for me to live a better life.
lines.zh: 我曾当面告诉她,我需要她受苦才能过上更好的生活——这种情况下,我可不会去催她。

lines.en: But I’m also not about to let the two of us drift any further away...so please excuse me while I attempt to reestablish some sort of status quo.
lines.zh: 但我也不会任由我们俩越漂越远……所以请容我尝试重建某种「往日状态」。

lines.en: : Noriko-
lines.zh: : Noriko——

lines.en: : So! You’re a...babysitter now? Or did you...maybe get back into tutoring during your free time or...or something?...
lines.zh: : 那么!你现在……当保姆了?还是说,你……也许在闲暇时间重新做起了家教,或者……什么的?……

lines.en: : Like I said, she’s a friend of a friend. Or a relative. Or a daughter of a friend. Whichever one is easiest to rationalize inside of your head.
lines.zh: : 就像我说的,她是个朋友的朋友。或者亲戚。或者朋友的女儿。哪个在你的脑子里最好合理化,就选哪个。

lines.en: : Hahah. Funny joke — implying that I’ve been able to rationalize literally anything at all lately.
lines.zh: : 哈哈。真好笑——暗示我最近居然还能把任何事合理化。

lines.en: : Still think it’s best that we spend a little time apart?
lines.zh: : 还是觉得我们最好分开一段时间?

lines.en: : Not even sure if we can with how my Dorm Wars contest is gonna work...
lines.zh: : 照我那场宿舍大战比赛的赛制,连能不能分开都不确定……

lines.en: : How is that going to work, by the way? Because I’m not sure I even understand.
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句,那要怎么进行?因为我都不确定自己看懂了没。

lines.en: : Neither are we, but...I think the goal is to just...get past your bodyguards and sort of “capture” you. Kind of like a capture the flag type thing, just...you’re the flag and we don’t need to take you back home.
lines.zh: : 我们也不确定,但……我觉得目标就是……突破你的保镖,然后把你「捕获」。有点像夺旗玩法,只是……你就是那面旗,而且我们不用把你扛回家。

lines.en: : Only issue with that is if we don’t finish that competition early, we might get stuck watching you all weekend long. Which...might create some issues.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是,要是比赛没能早早结束,我们可能整个周末都得看着你。这……可能制造一些问题。

lines.en: : For me, definitely. I think you’d be pretty good at that, though. You’ve got more experience watching me than anybody, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 对我来说,绝对是。不过我觉得你干那个会很在行。论「看着我」的经验,你比谁都丰富,不是吗?

lines.en: : I missed out on a few years since you’re an asshole, but...yeah.
lines.zh: : 因为你是混蛋,我错过了一些年头,但……对。

lines.en: : I do...
lines.zh: : 我有……

lines.en: : Can we start over?
lines.zh: : 我们能重新开始吗?

lines.en: : Like...not from the beginning, obviously. But from right before I went over to your house. That way, we could-
lines.zh: : 就是说……显然不是从头开始。而是从我正要去你家之前。那样,我们就可以——

lines.en: : That’s not a good idea.
lines.zh: : 那不是个好主意。

lines.en: : It’s...not?
lines.zh: : 不……好吗?

lines.en: : No, because it would mean forgetting everything you learned and everything we talked about that night. And even if that was painful for you, it’s important if we’re ever going to move forward.
lines.zh: : 不好,因为那意味着忘掉你学到的一切、忘掉那晚我们谈过的一切。哪怕那对你很痛,若想继续向前,这很重要。

lines.en: : I will say, though...it’s been kind of shitty not having you around.
lines.zh: : 不过我得说……身边没有你的日子,挺糟糕的。

lines.en: : Imagine how I feel...
lines.zh: : 你想象一下我的感受……

lines.en: : You’re the one keeping her distance. I’m ready to start hanging out with you again whenever you want.
lines.zh: : 保持距离的人是你。只要你愿意,我随时准备好重新和你出门。

lines.en: : Maybe...after the Dorm Wars. I just need a little more time to get my head straight and stuff. But the contest might be a good chance for me to do that.
lines.zh: : 也许……宿舍大战之后吧。我只需要再多一点时间理清思绪什么的。而那场比赛,对我或许是好机会。

lines.en: : I really...wasn’t expecting you to show up tonight. It threw my game off hard.
lines.zh: : 我真……没想到你今晚会出现。它把我的节奏彻底打乱了。

lines.en: : Well, I’ve been repeatedly throwing you off your game ever since you walked back into my life. So at least you’re starting to get used to it.
lines.zh: : 嗯,自从你重新走进我的生活,我就一直在反复打乱你的节奏。所以至少,你开始习惯了。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : At least there’s that...
lines.zh: : 至少还有这一条……

lines.en: And I arrive to be greeted by at least one concerned expression.
lines.zh: 而我抵达时,迎接我的至少有一副担忧的表情。

lines.en: : Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?
: Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please let me know if you have any questions about the menu.
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo 拉面。对菜单有任何疑问,请尽管问我。

lines.en: : No questions, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 没有疑问,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : In that case, may I ask one?
lines.zh: : 那样的话,我能问一个吗?

lines.en: : This is Nao. She’s a...friend of a friend.
lines.zh: : 这是 Nao。她是个……朋友的朋友。

lines.en: : Is that so?
lines.zh: : 是吗?

lines.en: : Then...Nao, if you have any questions about the menu or would like a recommendation, please let me know. I am the acting proprietor and resident flavor samurai. Those who doubt my power will be destroyed.
lines.zh: : 那么……Nao,你要是对菜单有任何疑问,或想要推荐,请告诉我。我是代理店主兼驻店风味武士。质疑我力量者,格杀勿论。

lines.en: : I am only kidding.
lines.zh: : 我只是开玩笑。

lines.en: : You may take a seat wherever you like, but I recommend the spot in the corner. It’s the closest to the fan and you’ll be able to watch me work from there.
lines.zh: : 你想坐哪儿都行,但我推荐角落那个位子。那里离风扇最近,你还能从那儿看我干活。

lines.en: : Does that sound interesting to you?
lines.zh: : 听起来有意思吗?

lines.en: : Excellent choice. Please take a moment to look over the menu. I will take your order momentarily.
lines.zh: : 绝佳的选择。请先过目菜单,我稍后就来为你点单。

lines.en: : You’re...surprisingly good with kids, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 你……意外地会应付小孩啊,Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : I simply excel in customer service. It’s no more or less than that.
lines.zh: : 我只是精通待客之道。仅此而已,不多不少。

lines.en: : Sorry...did nobody hear me when I said, “Whaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaat?” Because I can’t be the only one who wants a little more of an explanation for this mystery girl than “She’s a friend of a friend.”
lines.zh: : 抱歉……我说「什————么————」的时候没人听见吗?关于这个神秘女孩,想要比「她是个朋友的朋友」多一点解释的,不可能只有我一个吧。

lines.en: : Then allow me to explain. Is this seat taken?
lines.zh: : 那么请容我解释。这位子有人吗?

lines.en: : I don’t know. Do you have a friend of a friend of a friend who will be joining us as well? Or maybe a cousin of a distant uncle’s gardener’s pool boy?
lines.zh: : 不知道。你是不是也有个「朋友的朋友的朋友」要来?或者某个远房叔叔的园丁的泳池清洁工的表亲?

lines.en: : I do, but they won’t be here for another thirty minutes.
lines.zh: : 有,但他们还得三十分钟才到。

lines.en: : Oh, what luck. That means they’ll be showing up at the same time as my lawn guy’s nephew’s friend’s grandma and her talking platypus.
lines.zh: : 哦,真巧。那他们就会和「我家割草师傅的侄子的朋友的奶奶和她会说话的鸭嘴兽」同时出现了。

lines.en: : I’m very excited to meet them.
lines.zh: : 我很期待见到他们。

lines.en: : Sensei, who is that really? And why do her eyes look like a cross between Ami’s and Maya’s?
lines.zh: : Sensei,那孩子到底是谁?还有,她的眼睛怎么像 Ami 和 Maya 的混合?

lines.en: : Because they are. And also, she’s a random girl I found in an alleyway with another friend of mine who went on to adopt her.
lines.zh: : 因为就是混合。另外,她是我和另一个朋友在小巷里捡到的随机女孩,后来那位朋友领养了她。

lines.en: : Just what in the 90’s romance anime hell is going on here?
lines.zh: : 这里到底在演哪出九十年代恋爱动漫地狱戏码?

lines.en: : It’s insane, yes. Though, I’m a little surprised to see you just chalk it up to that and shrug it off.
lines.zh: : 是,离谱。不过,看到你只是把这归结为「离谱」然后耸耸肩,我反而有点惊讶。

lines.en: : You know, after our close closet call the other day, I’m not sure if anything’s going to surprise me anymore.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗,经历前几天衣柜里的千钧一发之后,我不确定还有什么能让我惊讶了。

lines.en: : Frankly, I’m still kind of creeped out by all of that. But I’m okay with chalking it up to just Ami being a borderline psychopath for now.
lines.zh: : 坦白讲,那件事我到现在还有点毛骨悚然。但我可以接受,暂时把它归结为「Ami 就是个边缘精神变态」。

lines.en: : That’s probably for the best.
lines.zh: : 那样大概最好。

lines.en: : What brings you over here, though? Are you working tonight?
lines.zh: : 不过,你怎么过来这边了?你今晚要上班?

lines.en: : Mhm. My shift’s in about an hour. I just came here to strategize with Tsuneyo since she’ll be my “teammate” for the Dorm Wars this year.
lines.zh: : 嗯。我的班一小时后开始。我只是来和 Tsuneyo 商量的,因为今年宿舍大战,她是我的「队友」。

lines.en: : How is that going to work, by the way? Because I’m not sure I really understand what the deal with that competition is.
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句,那要怎么进行?因为我不太确定自己真的搞懂了那场比赛的规则。

lines.en: : Neither are we, but...I think the goal is to just get past your bodyguards and sort of “capture” you. Kind of like a capture the flag type thing, just...you’re the flag and we don’t need to take you back home.
lines.zh: : 我们也不确定,但……我觉得目标就是突破你的保镖,然后把你「捕获」。有点像夺旗玩法,只是……你就是那面旗,而且我们不用把你扛回家。

lines.en: : Only issue with that is if we don’t finish that competition early, we might get stuck watching you all weekend long. Which...might create some issues.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是,要是比赛没能早早结束,我们可能整个周末都得看着你。这……可能制造一些问题。

lines.en: : For me, definitely. I think you’d be pretty good at that, though. You’ve got more experience watching me than anybody, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 对我来说,绝对是。不过我觉得你干那个会很在行。论「看着我」的经验,你比谁都丰富,不是吗?

lines.en: : Yup! You know me! Destined to chase after you for the rest of eternity instead of being the best Noriko I can be!
lines.zh: : 对!你懂我!注定要追赶你到永远,而不是成为最好的 Noriko!

lines.en: : I’m fine with a worse Noriko. The best one might be a little too good and it would only make everyone else jealous.
lines.zh: : 差一点的 Noriko 我也能接受。最好的那个 Noriko 或许太出色了,只会让其他人嫉妒。

lines.en: : I’ll be sure to repeatedly tell myself that the next time I get stuck in a closet.
lines.zh: : 下次我被卡在衣柜里的时候,我一定反复提醒自己这句话。

lines.en: : I like your shirt.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的衬衫。

lines.en: : Have you decided what you’d like to eat, Nao?
lines.zh: : 决定好想吃什么了吗,Nao?

lines.en: : House specialty tonkotsu ramen...okay.
lines.zh: : 本店招牌豚骨拉面……好。

lines.en: : You understand her too, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你也听得懂她,Tsuneyo?

lines.en: : Of course. I can tell what anyone wants to eat by simply looking at them.
lines.zh: : 当然。任何人想吃什么,我看一眼便知。

lines.en: : Then...why do you always ask?
lines.zh: : 那……你为什么总是要问?

lines.en: : Because it is the right thing to do. Now shut your mouth and let me converse with this child.
lines.zh: : 因为那才是正确之举。现在闭嘴,让我和这孩子交谈。

lines.en: : Nao, I take it you are not from around here?
lines.zh: : Nao,我猜你不是本地人?

lines.en: : You look awfully comfortable. Most people with knowledge of this area are rather cautious when it comes to entering establishments such as this one.
lines.zh: : 你看起来自在得出奇。了解这一带的人,走进这种店时多半相当谨慎。

lines.en: : Which would mean you either don’t understand where you are...or you understand it even better than I do. And seeing as I have been here my entire life, I’m quite sure it would have to be the former.
lines.zh: : 这意味着,你要么不明白自己身处何地……要么比我懂得还多。鉴于我在这里住了一辈子,我很确定是前者。

lines.en: : Forgive me. I’m sure I’m boring you when you would just like to eat.
lines.zh: : 恕我失礼。你明明只想吃饭,我肯定把你烦到了。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: : 但是……

lines.en: : Actually, remain there. It’s not often younger girls enter Tojo Ramen, but...I believe there is something stashed away from years past that may be of some use to you when it comes to keeping you busy.
lines.zh: : 其实,你留在原地。年轻女孩走进 Tojo 拉面的情况不多见,但……我相信这里存着一件多年前的旧物,或许能派上用场,让你有事情做。

lines.en: : If you do not like it, please feel free to throw it back in my face. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 你若不喜欢,请尽管把它摔回我脸上。谢谢。

lines.en: : Here — a small assortment of colored mechanical pencils and a suspiciously stiff sheet of paper for you to draw upon. Please scribble to your leisure while I prepare your meal.
lines.zh: : 给——一小盒彩色自动铅笔,和一张硬得出奇的纸,供你作画。请随意涂画,我去为你准备餐食。

lines.en: : There is no need to thank me. But I will accept a five star review on an Internet outlet of your choosing. It does help.
lines.zh: : 不必谢我。不过,你可以任选一个网络平台,给我打五星好评。那确实有帮助。

lines.en: : Wow...Tsuneyo’s in, like...mom mode right now. I’ve never seen this out of her before.
lines.zh: : 哇……Tsuneyo 现在,那个……切换成妈妈模式了。我从没见她这样过。

lines.en: : You should have seen Chika earlier. She was legitimately about to kidnap her.
lines.zh: : 你该看看早些时候的 Chika。她真的差一点就把她拐走了。

lines.en: : And that’s saying a lot since Chika’s already got one kid she’s taking care of, right?
lines.zh: : 这话可不轻——毕竟 Chika 手上已经有一个要照顾的孩子了,对吧?

lines.en: : Yeah, but...when did you learn about Chinami?
lines.zh: : 是啊,可是……你是什么时候知道 Chinami 的?

lines.en: : Long time ago. Chika mentioned something about her sister being really into Niki and I wound up getting her an autograph.
lines.zh: : 很久以前。Chika 提过一嘴,说她妹妹特别迷 Niki,结果我去给她弄了个签名。

lines.en: : I don’t mean to rain on your parade, but that autograph was probably for Chika. She’s kind of obsessed with your sister.
lines.zh: : 我不想泼冷水,但那个签名八成是给 Chika 的。她对你的姐姐有点痴迷。

lines.en: : I’m aware. It’s not the first time someone’s pulled that on me. Being the little sister of a famous idol comes with a fair share of stuff like that. You learn to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 我知道。又不是第一次有人对我来这套。当著名偶像的妹妹,这种事少不了。学会应对就好。

lines.en: : Isn’t Chika obsessed with you too, though? Does she, like...somehow not know about your history with Nee-san?
lines.zh: : 不过,Chika 不是也痴迷于你吗?难道她,那个……居然不知道你和 Nee-san 的过往?

lines.en: : I tried to tell her once but she wasn’t even remotely close to believing me.
lines.zh: : 我试过告诉她一次,但她离相信我差了十万八千里。

lines.en: : Did you offer to call her? Niki loves when you call her just to show off to people, you know. It doesn’t piss her off at all and you should totally keep doing it.
lines.zh: : 你提议过打电话给她吗?你知道,Niki 最喜欢你为了向人炫耀而打给她了。那完全不会惹恼她,你绝对应该继续。

lines.en: : I know you’re being sarcastic, but I will continue to do it anyway because it’s funny.
lines.zh: : 我知道你在讽刺,但我还是会继续,因为这很好笑。

lines.en: : Hey, as long as you’re not-
lines.zh: : 嘿,只要你们没有——

lines.en: : Wait, holding that thought. Your friend’s friend looks like she wants to show you her drawing.
lines.zh: : 等等,先记着这个思路。你的朋友的朋友好像想给你看她的画。

lines.en: : Cool, Nao...But what is it?
lines.zh: : 酷,Nao……可这是什么?

lines.en: : It’s a sweet album cover, that’s what it is.
lines.zh: : 那是一张很棒的专辑封面,这就是它是什么。

lines.en: : I believe she wants you to tell her you are proud of her.
lines.zh: : 我相信,她想听你说,你为她骄傲。

lines.en: : Nao, whenever you are done showing your drawing to this horrible man, your food is ready.
lines.zh: : Nao,等你给这个可怕的男人看完你的画,你的餐就备好了。

lines.en: : What the hell, Tsuneyo? You haven’t even taken my order yet.
lines.zh: : 搞什么,Tsuneyo?你连我的单都还没点。

lines.en: : You are not going to order. You aren’t hungry. I can sense it because I have noodle vision.
lines.zh: : 你不会点单的。你不饿。我感觉得到,因为我有面条视觉。

lines.en: : Good job, Nao...
lines.zh: : 干得好,Nao……

lines.en: : I’m very proud of you.
lines.zh: : 我非常为你骄傲。

lines.en: After running back to the counter to eat her ramen, Nao handed her drawing off to Tsuneyo so she could pin it to the fridge in the back.
lines.zh: 跑回柜台吃完她的拉面之后,Nao 把她的画交给了 Tsuneyo,好让她把画钉在后厨的冰箱上。

lines.en: It wasn’t just a kind gesture either. It seemed like Tsuneyo genuinely liked the picture for...whatever reason someone could possibly like something like that.
lines.zh: 而且那不只是客气的举动。Tsuneyo 似乎真心喜欢那张画——至于一个人可能出于什么理由喜欢那种东西,随便吧。

lines.en: But either way, it made Nao happy.
lines.zh: 但不管怎样,它让 Nao 开心了。

lines.en: And with new clothes covering the outside of her body and noodles covering the inside of it, it is safe to say that my job as a babysitter is now complete-
lines.zh: 随着新衣服盖住她身体的外部、面条填满她的内部,可以放心地说,我作为临时保姆的工作,如今已经完成——

lines.en: And that I can finally bring her back to Kaori’s apartment and return home to sleep or masturbate or something.
lines.zh: 也终于能把她送回 Kaori 的公寓,然后回家睡觉、自慰或者干点别的。

lines.en: Probably both. But it would be polite to wait until I’m outside of this restaurant and no longer watching Nao to start thinking about the next time I’m going to touch my penis.
lines.zh: 多半是两样都干。但礼貌起见,还是等我走出这家店、不再看着 Nao 之后,再开始盘算下一次碰我 penis 的时间吧。

lines.en: : Did you have a good time, Nao-chan? Isn’t Tsuneyo’s ramen the best?
lines.zh: : 玩得开心吗,Nao 酱?Tsuneyo 的拉面是不是最棒的?

lines.en: : Thank you for coming to Tojo Ramen.
lines.zh: : 感谢您光临 Tojo 拉面。

lines.en: : Please do not return again unless you bring Nao. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 除非带上 Nao,否则请不必再来。谢谢。

lines.en: : You’re all taking to her way too quickly. She can’t even talk.
lines.zh: : 你们也接纳她接纳得太快了吧。她话都不会说。

lines.en: : She doesn’t need to. One simply needs to observe Nao to understand Nao. It’s something you will never understand.
lines.zh: : 她不需要说话。只需观察 Nao,便能理解 Nao。那是你永远无法理解的事。

lines.en: : I...guess not.
lines.zh: : 我……大概是不懂。

lines.en: : But I should probably be getting her home now, so...say goodbye, Nao.
lines.zh: : 不过我大概该送她回家了,所以……说再见吧,Nao。

lines.en: : Bye-bye, Nao-chan! Have a good night and make sure to hold Sensei’s hand on the way home!
lines.zh: : 拜拜,Nao 酱!晚安,回家路上一定要牵好 Sensei 的手!

lines.en: : Goodbye, Nao. Make sure to do the exact opposite of what Noriko just said. Barring the “good night” portion, of course.
lines.zh: : 再见,Nao。务必做 Noriko 刚才所说内容的完全反面。当然,「晚安」那部分除外。

lines.en: : Okay. Thanks, Tsuneyo. Come on, Nao. Time to get you home.
lines.zh: : 好。谢了,Tsuneyo。走吧,Nao。该送你回家了。

lines.en: A solemn thing—it was—I said— \nA woman—white—to be—
lines.zh:
一件庄严的事——那曾是——我说——
做一个女人——一身白——

lines.en: And wear—if God should count me fit— \nHer blameless mystery—
lines.zh:
并穿上——若上帝认为我配——
她那无瑕的神秘——

lines.en: A hallowed thing—to drop a life \nInto the purple well—
lines.zh:
一件神圣的事——将一条生命
投入紫色的井——

lines.en: Too plummetless—that it return—
lines.zh: 太无坠锤——无法回返——

lines.en: Eternity—until—
lines.zh: 永恒——直至——

lines.en: : Well, Nao...It’s been real. But the time has come for me to go be an adult somewhere.
lines.zh: : 那么,Nao……这一切很真实。但时候到了,我要去某个地方当个成年人了。

lines.en: : Even if...there’s not much time left for me to be an adult since you consumed my entire Saturday.
lines.zh: : 即便……能当成年人的时间已经不多了,毕竟你吞掉了我整个星期六。

lines.en: : I texted Kaori on the way and she should be back soon. But she said you should have a key and that it’s fine if you’re alone for a little while.
lines.zh: : 路上我给 Kaori 发了消息,她应该快回来了。不过她说你有一把钥匙,而且你独自待一小会儿没关系。

lines.en: : She also wanted me to ask if you could feed John, but I’m not going to do that because it might be dangerous for you to go anywhere near him at this point in his...growth.
lines.zh: : 她还让我问一声,你能不能喂 John。但我不会开口,因为以它如今的……成长阶段,你靠近它任何地方都可能很危险。

lines.en: : Yeah...I’ll keep that in mind.
lines.zh: : 是啊……我会记住的。

lines.en: : You know-
lines.zh: : 你知道吗——

lines.en: : The more I think about it, the more I want to ask you...
lines.zh: : 我越想,就越想问你……

lines.en: : That...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : That drawing.
lines.zh: : 那张画。

lines.en: : What was that?
lines.zh: : 那是什么?

lines.en: : Like...was it just a thing you came up with? Or...
lines.zh: : 就是说……那只是你临场想出来的东西吗?还是……

lines.en: : Well, if it wasn’t something you came up with, then what-
lines.zh: : 好吧,如果那不是你临场想出来的,那是什么——
